SELECT

  CASE WHEN NOT success THEN response_time END AS Error

  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name) 
  AND sampler_name = '$sampler_name'

SELECT
time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time,
  sum(avg_rt * n) / NULLIF(sum(n), 0) as avg
FROM requests_raw_${cagg_suffix}
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' and test_environment = '$test_environment'
  AND sampler_name = '$sampler_name'
  AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

targets.query: SELECT (count("responseCode")  / $granularity) as value FROM "requestsRaw" WHERE ("success" = 'true') AND "samplerName" =~ /${URL}/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(${granularity}s), "samplerName" fill(none)
targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time,
  sum(n)::float / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '$__interval'::INTERVAL) as total,
  sum(n_err)::float / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '$__interval'::INTERVAL) AS Error
FROM requests_raw_${cagg_suffix}
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' and test_environment = '$test_environment' AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name) 
  AND sampler_name = '$sampler_name'
  AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT response_time,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY response_time) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
  FROM requests_raw
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' and test_environment = '$test_environment' AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name) 
    AND sampler_name = '$sampler_name'
    AND success IS TRUE
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * rn / total, 2) AS percentile,
  response_time AS value
FROM ordered
ORDER BY percentile;

SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', bucket) AS time,
  sampler_name,
  ROUND(sum(avg_response_size * n) / NULLIF(sum(n), 0))
FROM requests_raw_${cagg_suffix}
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' and test_environment = '$test_environment' AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name) AND
      sampler_name='$sampler_name' AND
      $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2;

targets.query: SELECT time, randomId, responseTime, responseCode, samplerName, url, transactionName, nodeName, responseMessage FROM "requestsError" WHERE "samplerName" = ${URL:singlequote}  AND $timeFilter order by time desc limit 100
targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  sampler_name,
  transaction_name,
  response_time,
  node_name,
  random_id,
  url,
  response_code,
  response_message
FROM requests_error
WHERE system_under_test = '$system_under_test' and test_environment = '$test_environment' AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name) AND
      $__timeFilter(time) AND 
      sampler_name='$sampler_name'
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 100;
